description: sprint-recap hooks: a SessionStart hygiene check (context only, silent unless the project uses sprint-recap) and a PreToolUse Bash gate that blocks git from staging the plugin's credential artifacts and asks before `git add --force` in a sprint-recap project.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start_config_check.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_commit_secret_gate.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
